docker build -f Dockerfile.agent -t course-agent .
description: The starter commands for the sixth exercise, which set up a writable workspace and a reference folder, then build the agent image.

steps.description: Create the project and reference folders under `~/agents`. The exercise uses the project folder as the writable workspace and the reference folder as the read-only reference.
Initialize a git repository in the project folder, so the agent's changes are trackable.
Build the agent image from `Dockerfile.agent` and tag it `course-agent`. The exercise then runs the three checks from Section 9.5.

title: Exercise 6 Starter: Build the Agent Fence
